api_version: 2025 BfG flood-depth service-feed discovery; exact protocol version unverified

request_contract.parameter_rules: DOCUMENTATION ONLY. BfG original-feed path was listed by harvested original-provider metadata at md.umwelt.info, but exact XML original bytes could not be fetched through the public research retrieval path (HTTP 403). No provider access test succeeded and no HTTP request, redirect, XML parse, linked data URL follow, download or publication is authorized under this contract. Never synthesize a WFS/WMS or asset URL from this feed path without separate original-provider validation and permission.

response_contract.format: Advertised XML service feed; no original payload read, content-type checked, feature layer sampled or data-file obtained
response_contract.scientific_semantics: German nationally harmonised HWRM-RL third-cycle 2022-2027 report of static inland/river and coastal flood-depth scenarios, not observed individual flood events or insurer losses. Lo/Me/Hi refer to low/medium/high probability scenarios, not a single standardized national annual probability without reviewing regional reporting metadata. Five binned depth classes; T_class combines protected/informational/inundation area type and depth bin (for example 23 denotes an informational area with 1-2 m depth), so T_class must not be interpreted as water depth in metres. National layer is not necessarily the current most detailed state or municipality layer; preserve source cycle, geographic coverage and missing areas.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: Only published feed metadata referenced; 403/unavailable through research retrieval. No active polling, service-capabilities request, data download or XML linked-resource traversal permitted.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Metadata record issued 2026-03-06; published feed path carries ueberflutungstiefen-2025. Do not interpret feed-path vintage as verified scientific data year or reuse rights. Future review must prove original feed byte hash, exact service/products, layer version, CRS, depth-class encoding and provider attribution.

rights_and_policy.notes: GovData lists BfG as publisher; harvested metadata indicates a public service feed. Public listing or claimed open data is not an exact rights confirmation for every linked GIS dataset, commercial automation, derivative publication or downstream raw bytes. Verify original authoritative terms and the current BfG/WasserBLIcK licence per product.
